themes.name: Disco Dumpling
themes.motto: ONE SMALL HOP. ONE BIG VIBE.

stages.hint: Find your rhythm. Small jumps, big brain.
Look where you want to land.
Slow down. Your brain cell needs balance.
Pink lava is still lava. Hop over it!
Watch the sweep, then jump the laser.
Mint means solid. Amber means move!
The arrows push. Steer against the drift.
The cyan spring gives a gentle extra hop.
Ride the cloud, or take the side stones.
Two lanes. Both work. Pick your vibe.
